_meta.purpose: workflow.output: a recurring 'daily brief' output using the proposed daily_brief_layout kit (GAP). Files delivery. Documents the registry's deepest GAP: empty bootstrap, no edit tools, no prompt pack, no export for workflow.output.

required_files_note: registry registers NO required_files for workflow.output today. This fixture proposes 'brief.md' as the conventional output but it is NOT contract-enforced (GAP).

manifest.starter_kit_note: registry registers no starter_kit; this fixture references the proposed daily_brief_layout kit (GAP), absent from kits/starter.py.
manifest.bootstrap_note: GAP: workflow.output registers an EMPTY bootstrap tool pack. Nothing scaffolds the output today.
manifest.edit_note: GAP: no edit tools registered for workflow.output.
manifest.prompt_pack_note: GAP: no build_workflow_output.md pack exists. Proposed in PROMPT_PACK_REQUIREMENTS.md.
manifest.export_note: GAP: no export pipeline registered for workflow.output.

semantic_metadata.note: Daily brief output is sectioned and time-stamped so each run is distinguishable. data-disco-version distinguishes successive daily runs; metric-id anchors tracked numbers.

attributes.source: workflow run date (one version per daily run)

tweak_metadata.note: workflow.output has no registered TweakSpec. Empty by design (and bootstrap/edit are GAP regardless).

entries.source_ref: workflow run -> brief.md (no governed bootstrap tool; GAP)

evidence_host_must_observe: a workflow output artifact exists (proposed brief.md) and is non-empty
the output is inspectable/downloadable (files delivery mode)
cited metrics/figures resolve to resource_manifest source_refs
GAP: because bootstrap/edit are empty, the host cannot assert HOW the output was produced via governed tools — verification can only check the resulting file, not the production path

export_expectations.gap_note: GAP: no export pipeline for workflow.output. The output is delivered as raw files only. Proposed remediation = a workflow_output export (e.g. bundle the brief + assets), see EXPORT_PIPELINE_SPEC.md.
